wiDetection.title: Detection panel
wiDetection.subtitle: Manually trigger the red-flag pipeline
wiDetection.runDetectionDesc: Runs every enabled rule against every wallet and recomputes scores. Use after a fresh ingest.
wiDetection.seedRulesDesc: Syncs every rule defined in code to the FlagRule table. Idempotent and safe to re-run.
wiDetection.explainerRun: Detection: runs every enabled rule against each wallet, persists new red flags, and recomputes the WalletScore.
wiDetection.explainerSeed: Seed: updates the rule table from code (default severity, description, params). Required after adding or editing rules in the repo.

wiRules.new_wallet_big_bet_desc: Recently created wallet already holds a position above the threshold — classic sock-puppet pattern.
wiRules.concentration_unilateral_desc: Wallet controls a disproportionate share of a single outcome — manipulation surface.
wiRules.whale_velocity_desc: Unusually heavy trading volume within a short rolling window.
wiRules.single_market_focus_desc: 100% of recent trades on a single market — narrow participation.
wiRules.trade_fragmentation_desc: Many small trades within 24h adding up to a large USD total — order-splitting pattern.
wiRules.coordinated_entry_desc: Several distinct wallets entered the same side of a market within a tight time window.
wiRules.funding_source_cluster_desc: Wallet shares a common funding origin with several others — Sybil pattern.
wiRules.wash_trading_internal_desc: Closed A→B→A trade loops between linked wallets.
wiRules.price_impact_unexplained_desc: Trade caused an outsized odds move not mirrored in sibling markets.
